name: proofloop
description: ProofLoop Research Copilot: moderated and unmoderated user testing, evidence-locked synthesis and findings fed back into prototypes, as a Claude Code and Cursor plugin.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-assets.mjs && esbuild src/server.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test:dist: npm run build && PROOFLOOP_SERVER=dist/server.mjs node --test test/*.test.mjs
